import sys

def min_cost_climbing_stairs(cost):
    n = len(cost)
    if n == 0 or n == 1:
        return 0
    dp_prev2 = 0  # cost to reach step i-2
    dp_prev1 = 0  # cost to reach step i-1
    for i in range(2, n + 1):
        cur = min(dp_prev1 + cost[i - 1], dp_prev2 + cost[i - 2])
        dp_prev2, dp_prev1 = dp_prev1, cur
    return dp_prev1

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    cost = list(map(int, data[1:1 + n])) if n > 0 else []
    result = min_cost_climbing_stairs(cost)
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
